slots.dense-delivery-relationships/title: Named responsibilities and client decision rights anchor the delivery model
slots.dense-delivery-relationships/client-b-0/: Sponsor and steering committee own investment and scope gates.
slots.dense-delivery-relationships/client-b-2/: Architecture lead owns interface and control decisions with the client enterprise architect.
slots.dense-delivery-relationships/client-b-3/: Three delivery pods cover journey experience, integration, and platform enablement. Each pod has a lead and bounded mix of engineering, analysis, and quality roles.

slots.dense-delivery-relationships/client-read: Client role availability and decision rights need confirmation during mobilization.
slots.dense-delivery-relationships/shared-spec: Shared security, data, change, and service specialists participate at defined gates.
slots.dense-delivery-relationships/staffing-bo: The 21-role organization diagram represents responsibilities and reporting relationships, not 21 full-time people.
The diagram is a responsibility model, not an FTE count or named staffing commitment.
slots.slide/takeaway: Decision ownership is explicit across sponsorship, program coordination, architecture, pods, and client counterparts.
